title: Cut-proof escrow rotation and automated evidence export playbook for admin audit logs
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Objective: implement an automated, region-aware evidence generation and escrow rotation workflow for admin audit logs (admin actions, access events, and configuration changes). The output must be cut-proof (cannot be retroactively altered or reordered), verifiable, and exportable on legal hold within retention and residency constraints. This ticket covers the design and implementation of: 1) deterministic snapshot manifests for audit streams, 2) WORM-backed storage lifecycle (object-lock + retention manifests) with KMS envelope wrapping, 3) HSM-backed signing and Merkle anchoring of snapshot batches, 4) automated periodic escrow bundle rotation and cross-region handoff playbook, and 5) reporting hooks for evidence proofs and export telemetry. Work spans hosted and Private deployments and must respect tenant residency, retention policy overrides, and enterprise export requests.
acceptance_criteria: Periodic snapshot job produces deterministic, byte-stable bundle and manifest for each retention window
Bundles are signed with HSM-backed key and produce a Merkle root stored in KMS-protected metadata
Object store uses immutable retention (S3 Object Lock / equivalent) and lifecycle prevents deletion before retention expiry
Playbook automates rotation: bundle creation -> notarization -> escrow copy -> region-cutproof transfer -> verification
Export API returns a tamper-evident bundle with attached verification artifacts (signature, Merkle proof, notarization timestamp)
Audit console shows per-tenant export readiness, last notarization timestamp, and chain-of-custody trace
Automated alerts on any verification failure or incomplete escrow replication within SLA
tasks: Design deterministic bundle format and stable manifest schema (include sequence windows, start/end offsets)
Integrate HSM signing flow and define key rotation policy for escrow signing keys
Implement Merkle tree builder for batch snapshots and persist root in signed manifest
Wire S3 Object Lock + retention setting APIs and test behaviour in both hosted and Private environments
Build escrow rotation worker: create bundle, notarize (timestamp service), replicate to escrow region, mark lifecycle
Expose export-from-escrow endpoint that returns bundle + verification artifacts and access audit record
Create console views for evidence status and runbook links for legal/forensics teams
Write end-to-end test harness that simulates region partition and verifies cut-proof properties
decisions: Use HSM-backed signing (cloud KMS with HSM or on-prem HSM depending on deployment) rather than app-level keys
Merkle anchoring will be persisted in signed manifests and optionally anchored to third-party time-stamping service for stronger non-repudiation
Escrow copies will be encrypted with tenant-wrapped keys and stored in region-specific buckets to satisfy residency
Retention enforcement will prefer immutable object-lock semantics over rely-on-application deletion guards
Legal-hold exports use pre-signed, time-limited access with bundled verification artifacts included
